finalText:
**Redis died and took the service with it.** No app bug.

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `Redis` at `10.0.0.12:6379` refuses connects, cache falls back to direct store reads ([app.log:182](logs/app.log#L182)) |
| 02:14–02:31 | Queue depth climbs 52 to 568, past the max of 500 |
| 02:31:45 | `worker-2` dies of heap exhaustion, code 134 |
| 02:31:52 | `api` killed, service down |

All 13 reconnect tries got `ECONNREFUSED`, so the `Redis` box was down the whole 17 minutes, not flapping.

Next: check why `Redis` stopped at 02:14, and cap the queue so a cache loss sheds load instead of running out of memory.
